name: Navidrome Statistic
install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && npm ci

terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.description: Navidrome Statistic FastAPI dev server on http://localhost:39421 (liveness at /health, readiness at /health/ready). It starts with no upstream Navidrome source configured, so /health/ready reports 'degraded' until NAVIDROME_* env vars are provided or a source is added under Settings > Connections. Restart this terminal after changing source configuration.
